design_source: PR34041 worktree; design not yet merged into reviewed main

findings.risk: A holds the full multi-scope snapshot; reusing it after B either rejects a changed target or overwrites B.
findings.required_behavior: Project only the authoritative A frame into latest shared context; preserve every unrelated scope and conversation.

findings.risk: record does not verify active scope or provider attempt ownership.
findings.required_behavior: Join semantic execution and physical attempt ownership; retire callbacks before another attempt or B starts.

findings.risk: CAS storage error can represent uncertain commit; blindly appending again duplicates evidence.
findings.required_behavior: Keep exact pre-state and desired post-state, reread same identity, and publish only confirmed state. Do not turn one execution conflict into the Owner global storage latch.

findings.risk: Refreshing historical observations from each new journal revision counts current tool calls twice.
findings.required_behavior: Freeze historical repetition baseline at attempt start; persist ongoing observations separately.

limits: These are native-integration preconditions and source risks, not proof that each scenario occurred live.
No automatic resume, data mutation, local build or runtime acceptance test performed.
